The '''Skyspear Forest''' was a forest on the [[Double Worlds|Twin World]] of [[Talus/Legends|Talus]].<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Skyspear Forest is one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
